infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: NyayaSetu requires microphone access for voice-based legal problem intake in Hindi and English.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: NyayaSetu requires photo access to attach case documents, Bar Council certificates, and Legal CVs.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: NyayaSetu requires camera access to scan physical legal documents and certificates.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: NyayaSetu uses your location to discover nearby advocates, High Courts, and district chambers.
